speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Jaundice (Physiologic or Pathologic)

The symptoms you described—yellowing starting at the face and spreading to the trunk with scleral icterus—are classic for jaundice in a newborn. Acute appendicitis is extremely rare in neonates and does not present with these specific signs. I have already ordered bilirubin levels and skin imaging; please wait for those results to determine if this is physiologic or due to something like hemolysis or sepsis.
